Site: Hiwaii Shop
URL: https://www.hiwaii.store
Primary language: en
Additional language: vi

Scope:
- Lifestyle-first Hawaiian shirt storefront.
- Niche taxonomy: Animal, Art & Music, Vintage.
- Product pages include size/material variants, pricing, media gallery, and size chart.

Allowed use for AI discovery:
- Summarization and citation for product discovery, navigation, and comparison.
- Indexing of public product and collection pages.

Disallowed:
- Republishing full-page content verbatim.
- Generating misleading brand claims or altered pricing.

Canonical policy:
- Canonical host is https://www.hiwaii.store
- Localized Vietnamese URLs use ?lang=vi

Key routes:
- https://www.hiwaii.store/
- https://www.hiwaii.store/collections
- https://www.hiwaii.store/product/{id}
